## Press Release


### Republic Bancorp, Inc. Declares Regular Quarterly Cash Dividend and Announces Special Cash Dividend


Company Release - 11/18/2026 4:00 PM ET


Download the PDF version PDF Format (opens in new window)


LOUISVILLE, Ky.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Republic Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: RBCAA), parent company of Republic Bank & Trust Company, announced today that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.495 per share on Class A Common Stock and $0.45 per share on Class B Common Stock, payable January 15, 2027, to shareholders of record as of December 18, 2026.


In addition to the regular quarterly dividend, the Board of Directors declared a one-time special cash dividend of $5.50 per share on Class A Common Stock and $5.00 per share on Class B Common Stock. The one-time special dividend is payable January 8, 2027, to shareholders of record as of December 11, 2026.


“The special dividend reflects the Company’s strong capital position, consistent profitability, and commitment to delivering long-term value to our shareholders,” said Logan Pichel, President and Chief Executive Officer of Republic Bank & Trust Company. “Republic has a long history of maintaining a strong capital foundation while returning capital to shareholders through regular dividends and other shareholder-focused initiatives. Following payment of the special dividend, the Company is expected to remain among the best capitalized banks in the country and significantly above ‘well-capitalized’ under regulatory capital standards, while also positioned to execute on our long-term growth strategy.”


“We are pleased to provide this additional return of capital to our shareholders,” said Steve Trager, Executive Chair of Republic Bancorp, Inc. “Republic's success has been built on a long-standing commitment to sound banking principles, exceptional customer service, and disciplined execution. This special dividend reflects the strength of our franchise and our confidence in the Company’s long-term outlook.”


*Republic Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company”) is the parent company of Republic Bank & Trust Company (the “Bank”). The Bank operates 47 banking centers across five metropolitan statistical areas (“MSAs”) in five states. These include 22 banking centers in the Louisville MSA, serving Louisville, Prospect, Shelbyville, and Shepherdsville, Kentucky, and Floyds Knobs, Jeffersonville, and New Albany, Indiana; six banking centers in the Lexington MSA, serving Georgetown and Lexington, Kentucky; eight banking centers in the Cincinnati MSA, serving Kenwood, Norwood, and West Chester, Ohio, and Bellevue, Covington, Crestview Hills, and Florence, Kentucky; seven banking centers in the Tampa MSA, serving Largo, New Port Richey, Seminole, St. Petersburg, Tampa, and Temple Terrace, Florida; and four banking centers in the Nashville MSA, serving Cool Springs, Murfreesboro, Nashville, and Spring Hill, Tennessee. The Bank also offers online banking at*[www.republicbank.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.republicbank.com&esheet=54643170&newsitemid=20261118270473&lan=en-US&anchor=www.republicbank.com&index=1&md5=18008034df4b7f93ef8a3b42a1d79d5a) *. The Company is headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky and, as of September 30, 2026, had approximately $7.08 billion in total assets. The Company’s Class A Common Stock is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol “RBCAA.”*


**Republic Bank. Time to Thrive.** ™
